'''Corrdair''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Corrdair system/Legends|Corrdair system]] of the [[Hevvrol sector/Legends|Hevvrol sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The [[Battle of Corrdair]] took place there.
